2.264.15
MapViewport.MaximumZoom
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The MapViewport.MaximumZoom element specifies the maximum zoom level that is allowed in a
Map element. The MapViewport.MaximumZoom element is optional.
If this element is present, its value MUST be a Float ([XMLSCHEMA2] section 3.2.4) or an expression
that evaluates to a Float. If this element is not present, its value is interpreted as 20000.
Following is the parent element of the MapViewport.MaximumZoom element.
Parent elements
MapViewport
The following is the XML Schema definition of the MapViewport.MaximumZoom element.
 <xsd:element name="MaximumZoom" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
